With all the hype around Grand Theft Auto 6 and its ray tracing, it's a little disappointing to see that Rockstar hasn't updated Red Dead Redemption 2 with RT - but fear not, modder Badass Baboon has delivered RT shadows, RTAO and, best of all, RTGI for the game. And here's what we think. Many thanks to Rayan for checking out the mod, writing this video and editing it.
